target_statement: A single Turan witness replicates on many half-integer shell centers; an averaged retained-hat fourth moment and a sufficiently numerous event-conditioned radialization set then contradict each other.
first_unproved_edges: averaged-in-shell-center GCG4 for the retained adjacent-gap hat
event-conditioned radialization on enough phase-aligned centers
mask_or_node_class: Actual ordinary primes in each fixed logarithmic shell; the upper antenna is the exact retained adjacent-prime hat.
source_data_retained: One fixed prime interval I and one common ordinate tau supplied by a Turan witness; only the center Y varies through the interval that contains I in its shell.
coefficient_cone_and_sign: Nonnegative retained-hat probability for the upper certificate; full signed dual cone inside LTRAD_P for the lower return.
normalization: Turan source depth is N^{-1} times the prime cosine sum; retained-hat coefficients have total mass one.
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: H_Y=[Y^.01,Y^(50/33)]; fourth moment is integrated on the persistence-safe translated band [Y^(839/1000),2Y^(50/33)].
quantifier_order: One fixed witness (I,tau), then many eligible half-integer centers Y; the upper theorem may fail on a controlled exceptional set, and lower radialization need hold on a set larger than that exceptional set.
resolution_required: No new prime-log resolution in the phase replication lemma; the open averaged GCG4 still sees product ratios at B^{-1}=Y^{-50/33}.

rate_and_exponent_ledger.phase_discrepancy_at_A=50/33: O(N^{-16/99}) from optimized Erdos--Turan truncation, up to constants

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: Turan contraposition supplies a fixed interval sum S_I at a common tau; the eligible center interval has length comparable to N and phase arcs have positive asymptotic density.
downstream_socket: Together with the audited Turan localization theorem, the coupled upper/lower center-set intersection excludes a zero in the contemplated width-10^{-6} strip.
parallel_open_siblings: Any amplifier from the contemplated near-one strip to RH
why_not_target_renamed: The phase-density and exceptional-set intersection are elementary adapters. They strictly weaken uniformity in Y but do not estimate either the averaged fourth moment or the radial return.

fast_falsifiers.abstract_convex: Scale-global LTRAD can concentrate its one large radius entirely inside the exceptional upper set, so it is insufficient.
fast_falsifiers.fejer_half_grid: Phase coverage survives a half-grid, but no upper or lower radial theorem follows from it.
fast_falsifiers.prime_density_pseudonode: Center averaging removes the global Y^{-it} phase from |F_Y|^4, so density smoothing alone cannot create conductor cancellation. Positive mixtures of canonical hats produce gap/Voronoi weights and order-one leakage outside the Turan interval, not its uniform counting measure.
fast_falsifiers.finite_actual_prime: Finite center counts may check the phase-count formula only; they cannot establish either open asymptotic input.

actual_prime_arithmetic_line: All unproved power saving remains in the actual adjacent-gap-weighted balanced-semiprime correlation and in actual-prime source-conditioned radialization.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: Replace two uniform-in-center locks by a coupled density-exponent inequality: upper exceptional-count exponent plus lower success-count exponent must force intersection.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: Return to uniform DPA_P plus centerwise/scale-global LTRAD; the zero-coherence quantifier reversal supplies no route reduction.
stop_rule: Do not claim a strip unless both open density inputs are proved with compatible center sets; do not infer a center gain merely from averaging |F_Y|^4, whose global center phase cancels.
